definition.description: Stores chat messages. Includes denormalized 'studentId' for authorization independence and efficient querying. This allows for direct querying of all messages by a specific user without additional lookups. Chat history older than 15 days is automatically purged.

params.name: chatMessageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the chat message.

definition.description: Stores file upload metadata. Includes denormalized 'studentId' for authorization independence and efficient querying. This allows for direct querying of all file uploads by a specific user without additional lookups.

params.name: fileUploadId
params.description: The unique identifier for the file upload.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the Studygram community's chat and file-sharing features while ensuring security and scalability. It leverages path-based ownership for student data and denormalization to avoid complex security rules. The structure is also designed to be easily debuggable and maintainable.

Students are stored under `/students/{studentId}`.  Chat messages are stored under `/chat_messages/{chatMessageId}` with a denormalized `studentId` to facilitate querying messages by student and enforcing security rules without needing to perform `get()` operations. File uploads are stored under `/file_uploads/{fileUploadId}` and include the `studentId`. This denormalization enables efficient list operations (QAPs) without requiring complex filtering in security rules. The structure also segregates data based on access needs, ensuring that all documents within a collection share the same security posture.

Authorization Independence is achieved by denormalizing the `studentId` in both `/chat_messages` and `/file_uploads`. This allows security rules to validate ownership (`request.auth.uid == resource.data.studentId`) without needing to fetch the parent `Student` document.

QAPs are supported by segregating chat messages and files into dedicated collections with denormalized `studentId`, enabling secure and efficient listing of resources associated with a specific student.
